For the State : Mr. Arup Kr. Dey, A.P.P.

For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Kaushik Sarkhel, Advocate  ---
07/20.04.2023  Heard the parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Golmuri P. S. Case No. 42/2022, registered under Sections 498A, 341, 323, 376(2)/34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 4 of the Muslim Women Protection of Right on Marriage Act, 2019,
pending in the Court of Ms. Jyotsna Pandey, learned J.M., 1 st Class, Jamshedpur.
Petitioner is the husband of the informant.

entities.text: Muslim Women Protection of Right on Marriage Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Their marriage was solemnized in the year 2021.
It is alleged that after marriage, the informant was subjected to various atrocities.
In fact Uncle of this petitioner had also raped her.
It is further alleged that on 26.03.2022, the informant was assaulted in her matrimonial home, in order to save herself, she locked her room and informed the police.
It was submitted that police has submitted the final form against other co-accused persons including uncle of the petitioner against whom, there is allegation of rape.

It appears from the case diary that the tower location of the petitioner and other male members was not found near the matrimonial home of the informant at the time when, it is alleged that she was Ahmad Shuraid Khan @ Ahmad Shuraid vs The State Of Jharkhand on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132198890/
1 assaulted by the petitioner.

entities.text: Ahmad Shuraid Khan @ Ahmad Shuraid vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It further appears that certain articles were alleged to have been purchased and given to the petitioner, but from paragraph-159 of the case diary, it transpired that during the course of investigation it could not be ascertained, who had purchased the articles, which is alleged to be given to the petitioner.
Mr. Kaushik Sarkhel, learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 has vehemently opposed the prayer for Anticipatory Bail.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Ms. Jyotsna Pandey, learned J.M., 1 st Class, Jamshedpur or her successor in connection with Golmuri P. S. Case No. 42/2022.

Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
